create_D360_dataset: create a D360 PyTorch dataset instance with a data root, split, and modality config
load_multimodal_sensor_data: load multimodal sensor data including RGB, IMU, mic, pressure, and specgram from NumPy files
initialize_D360_with_modality: initialize a D360 dataset with independent or fused modality mode and trajectory length
get_D360_item: get a data sample by index returning a dict of sensor tensors, material, and labels
review_D360_class: review the D360 Dataset class that loads and normalizes multimodal Digit360 sensor trajectories
